about: The engine's neutral vocabulary (docs/packs/format.md, section 'Mechanics'). A pack maps its own mechanic names to these ids in rules.json 'mechanics'. kind: keyword = a tag a card can carry from its data and that the engine reads; hook = the card has a hook of this kind (shown to players, no tag); marker = a hint for the client only; state = a tag the engine sets during a game (a pack may name it, cards do not carry it). silenced = Silence removes it.

keywords.about: Enemies must attack a minion with it first (while it is not stealthed).
Can attack the turn it is played.
The first damage it would take is prevented and the barrier is lost.
Can attack twice each turn.
Cannot be attacked or targeted by the enemy until it attacks.
Cannot be targeted by spells or powers.
Cannot be targeted by the opponent's spells or powers (its own player's can); only in a pack that names it.
Cannot attack.
Can attack minions (not champions) the turn it comes into play or under a new player's control; with HASTE, anything. Only in a pack that names it.
Cannot attack champions (only minions; a forced redirect still may).
Can attack any number of times each turn; a weapon's lets its champion (with a weapon's CANT_ATTACK_HEROES, only minions).
Takes no damage.
Destroys any minion it damages.
Its number is added to the damage of its owner's spells (card field spell_power).
Locks that many of its owner's mana next turn (card field mana_lock).
A hidden spell that goes off on an event in the opponent's turn. The zone that holds traps is named after the pack's TRAP mechanic.

A spell that, played, waits in its player's trap zone in sight of both players (one at a time, within limits.secrets) while its hooks count toward a goal; a deck's task cards start in the opening hand. Not a trap: `g.traps` leaves it out, `g.tasks` lists it.
The damage it deals also restores that much Health to its owner's champion (a weapon's: its champion's attacks; healing turned into damage hurts the champion once). Only in a pack that names it.

A minion that holds its place on the board and is nothing else: no target, no attacker or defender, takes no damage, can't be destroyed, in no list of minions or characters (its own hooks still run; `g.transform` wakes it).
The card freezes what it hits (the effect is the card's hook).
The card silences (the effect is the card's hook).
The card counters a card (the effect is the card's hook).
The card summons a token that grows each time its player summons one (the effect is the card's hook, the count `g.add_count`).
The card offers its player three of a list of upgrades for minions (its hook: `g.create`, `g.request_choice`); only that player sees them.
The card summons a random minion of its player's deck that matches (the effect is the card's hook: `g.summon_entity`); Kobolds & Catacombs' Recruit.
The card casts itself when its player draws it, then that player draws another (the effect is the card's `hand.draw` hook).
Played from the hand, the card gives its player a new copy of itself that goes away at the end of the turn (the effect is the pack's scripts); The Witchwood's Echo.
The card does something from its player's deck when the game starts (the effect is the pack's player hooks: `game_start`); The Witchwood's Start of Game.
The card offers its player a choice of cards (the effect is the card's hook: `g.create`, `g.request_choice`); only that player sees the options.
Does something when played from the hand.
Does something when it dies.
Does something after its owner uses the champion's power (an `on` hook on the `hero_power` event).
A bonus when another card was played before it this turn.
The player picks one of two effects.
A bonus while it is damaged (an aura condition).
Has an ongoing effect.
Reacts to events (the client shows a mark).
Its effect touches the neighbours.
Its numbers grow with spell power.
Spell power does not change it.
Misses its next attack.
Was frozen this turn (keeps the freeze through the turn end).
Cannot attack this turn (just played, no haste).
How many times it attacked this turn.
A champion's armor.
A weapon's durability.
The power was used this turn.
The power cannot be used (a tutorial rule).
The champion cannot be attacked while its side has minions (a tutorial rule).
Dies in the next death phase.
The board position it died at.
Doubles the damage and healing of its owner's spells and power (an aura tag).
Its owner's healing deals damage instead (an aura tag).
Its owner's minions run their ON_DEATH hooks twice (an aura tag on the champion).
Its owner plays, attacks and uses the power on a random one of the valid targets instead of the chosen one (an aura tag on the champion; only in a pack that names it).
Its owner's ON_PLAY hooks (not COMBO, not CHOICE) run twice, on the same target (an aura tag on the champion).

Its owner's CHOICE cards have both effects: one play with choice 2, the target of the first option that has one, then a `both` hook or the two options' effects in card order (an aura tag on the champion).
The `turn_end` hooks of its owner's entities (cards and enchantments) run once more per count, at the end of either player's turn (an aura tag on the champion, a count). Only in a pack that names it.
The mana a card cost when it was played from the hand (cost changes included). Written only by packs that name it in rules.json mechanics (a new tag changes the state).
Added to the damage of its owner's power before POWER_MULTIPLIER doubles it (an aura tag on the champion, a count: `g.hp_dmg`).
How many times the power was used this turn, on the power. Written only by packs that name it in rules.json mechanics.
How many times its owner used a power this game, on the champion (kept by a new champion). Written only by packs that name it in rules.json mechanics.
How far a task (a Quest) has come; its scripts keep it, clients show it.
Where a task (a Quest) is fulfilled; its scripts set it, clients show it.
The turn a minion died. Written only by packs that name it in rules.json mechanics (a new tag changes the state).
